text: きょうの　ビリリダマは　すげえ　しびれさすぜ！

structure.jp: きょうの　ビリリダマは

patterns.name: 〜させる
patterns.explanation: させる on a verb means 'make someone do it'; さす is a shorter, rougher form. しびれさす = 'make you go numb'.

patterns.name: 〜ぜ
patterns.explanation: ぜ at the end is a rough, cocky way of telling someone something. しびれさすぜ = 'it'll zap you, man'.
